b1.speaker: bull
b1.text: ……五百年。压在山下的七弟，也爬出来了。
b1.en: …Five hundred years. So the seventh brother has crawled out from under his mountain.

m1.speaker: monkey
m1.text: 平天大圣好定力。一坐千年，连火都坐倦了。
m1.en: The Great Sage Who Levels Heaven sits well. A thousand years — even the fire has grown tired.

b2.speaker: bull
b2.text: 又来借扇？上回钻我妻的肚子——这回，钻哪儿？
b2.en: Come to borrow the fan again? Last time you crawled into my wife's belly. This time — where?

b3.speaker: bull
b3.text: 红孩儿的账，铁扇的账……今日一并算。
b3.en: Red Boy's debt. Iron Fan's debt… Today we settle them all.

m3.speaker: monkey
m3.text: 正好。俺老孙压了五百年，骨头正痒。
m3.en: Good. Five hundred years under a mountain — my bones are itching.

p1.speaker: bull
p1.text: 坐了一千年……也该站起来，看看这天了。
p1.en: A thousand years seated… Time I stood, and had a look at this sky.

p2.speaker: monkey
p2.en: Stand, then. The taller you stand, the louder you fall.

p4.speaker: monkey
p4.text: ……好。论大小，俺老孙也会。——法相天地！
p4.en: …Fine. Size? I can do size. — Stand as Heaven and Earth!

e0.speaker: bull
e0.text: 好棍……七弟。这火，烧了一千年……也该熄了。
e0.en: A good blow… seventh brother. A thousand years this fire has burned… time it went out.
